prompt.alinti: CC Baga cleans up your Cloud setup and proves the change actually worked.
It's a free desktop app for Mac, Windows, and Linux.
Save your current Cloud setup, switch to a saved one, or start fresh.
It also sets your language and time zone to the region you pick, then restarts your browser.
Then it checks that your browser, your computer, and your connection all agree.
When they match, you get a green page and a big checkmark.
It's for people living or traveling abroad who manage their own Cloud accounts.
Comment BAGA and I'll send you the repo link.
